IIT Kharagpur student dies after falling from campus building

A second-year mechanical engineering student at IIT Kharagpur died after falling from the third floor of the Nalanda complex on campus. The incident occurred at the Nalanda building. This is reported as the third death of an engineering student at the institute this year.
